name: vex-sim-runner
description: Build and launch the VEX V5 simulator from a PROS project

vexsim.simDirectory.description: Absolute path to the root of the Vex Sim project (contains CMakeLists.txt)

vexsim.cmakePreset.description: CMake configure preset to use (from CMakePresets.json in the sim directory)

vexsim.robot.wheelRadiusIn.description: Drive wheel radius in inches (3.25" wheel → 1.625)

vexsim.robot.trackWidthIn.description: Distance between left and right wheel centers in inches

vexsim.robot.maxRpm.description: Motor cartridge max RPM (200 = red, 600 = blue, 1800 = green)

vexsim.robot.massKg.description: Robot mass in kg — used to derive the inertia time constant

vexsim.robot.driveMotorCount.description: Total number of drive motors (left + right) — used for inertia calculation

vexsim.robot.gearFriction.description: Gear mesh friction coefficient (0 = none, 1 = full extra braking force). Adds resistive torque from drivetrain friction during coast and brake modes.

vexsim.robot.leftPorts.description: Left drive motor port numbers (up to 4)

vexsim.robot.rightPorts.description: Right drive motor port numbers (up to 4)

vexsim.robot.trackingLeftPort.description: Left tracking wheel rotation sensor port (0 = use drive motor encoders)

vexsim.robot.trackingRightPort.description: Right tracking wheel rotation sensor port (0 = disabled)

vexsim.robot.trackingMidPort.description: Middle (strafe) tracking wheel rotation sensor port (0 = disabled)

vexsim.robot.widthIn.description: Robot width in inches (used for field boundary collision)

vexsim.robot.heightIn.description: Robot height/length in inches (used for field boundary collision)

vexsim.robot.startX.description: Robot start X position in inches from field center (right = positive)

vexsim.robot.startY.description: Robot start Y position in inches from field center (up = positive)

vexsim.robot.startHeadingDeg.description: Robot start heading in degrees (0 = facing up/North, clockwise = positive)
